title: Akira Ransomware Strikes Krycler, Ervin, Taubman & Kaminsky
content_md: Summary On October 1, 2026 , the notorious ransomware group Akira announced their responsibility for a cyberattack against Krycler, Ervin, Taubman & Kaminsky ( ketkcpa.com ), a prominent accounting and consulting firm based in Sherman Oaks, California. The group has threatened to release 88GB of sensitive data, including employee and client documentation, unless their ransom demands are met. Incident Report Field Details Target Krycler, Ervin, Taubman & Kaminsky Domain ketkcpa.com Country USA Attacking Group Akira Date Reported October 1, 2026 Threat Actor Statement “We will upload 88gb of corporate data soon. lots of employee documents (passports, DLs, SSN, death and birth certs), financials, insurance, credit cards, client information, NDAs and so on.” Recommended Security Actions Ransomware attacks are increasingly targeting both enterprise and mid-sized organizations across all sectors. The following steps are critical to reduce impact and prevent future incidents: Monitor continuously: Use DeXpose’s dark web and infostealer monitoring platform to detect breached credentials, leaked databases, and threat actor chatter in near real-time—before damage spreads internally.
